Five picks for a polished HolyArrs

50 unique desktop web screens visually reviewed on October 17, 2026. These are reference screenshots, not HolyArrs mockups. Interaction, mobile behavior and accessibility were not tested. Artwork-focused browsing and clear management views are judged separately.

Top fiveAll 50 and review notesComplete source record

Recommendation: Keep Overseerr as the familiar product foundation. Use Apple Music for restraint, Spotify for browsing, Linear for management, Air for filtering and Revolut for dark surface depth. Adapt these principles into one system; do not combine five visual themes.

1. Apple Music — Best overall polish

Artwork carries the color. The navigation, small labels and surfaces stay quiet. Use for Library and title details.

Open original on Mobbin · Review #21

2. Spotify — Best media discovery

Artwork shelves, clear section headings and a persistent library make this feel like a media product. Use for Home and Explore.

Open original on Mobbin · Review #43

3. Linear — Best management density

Consistent rows, restrained status colors and compact filters make complex work scannable. Use for Downloads, History and decisions.

Open original on Mobbin · Review #11

4. Air — Best library tools

Search, filter chips and orderly thumbnails support a large collection. Use for Library filters and saved views, where supported.

Open original on Mobbin · Review #9

5. Revolut Business — Best dark surfaces

Layered dark panels and restrained accents provide depth without harsh outlines. Use as a dark-theme reference.

Open original on Mobbin · Review #31
